customerId.description: Optional at intake so missing customer information can be assessed rather than rejected.

policyId.description: Optional at intake so a missing policy reference can be reported as an assessment finding.

vehicleId.description: Optional at intake so missing vehicle information can be assessed.

lossDate.description: Optional at intake so missing loss-date information can be assessed.

reportedDate.description: Date the claim was first reported, not an artifact upload date. Missing dates require handler follow-up for the Section 4 deadline check.

reportedDriverId.description: Optional at intake so missing driver information can be assessed.

claimantStatement.description: Optional at intake; absence is a completeness finding.

artifactIds.description: Optional at intake; an absent or empty list can indicate missing evidence.
